job: Read a post, report or paper at reading length, with its sources and notes.
purpose: The reading page, as one section: a head (breadcrumb, eyebrow, title, standfirst, authors and date, actions), an optional cover, the body (fd-prose at reading size, with figures, tables and pull quotes breaking out of the measure) and a foot of ruled rows (notes, references, cite this, tags, copy link, the authors, a sign-up). plain is one column, aside adds a sticky rail that becomes a disclosure below desktop, cover spans the head over a wide frame.
useWhen: A post, a newsletter issue or a story on the site.
A report or a research paper read on the page before or instead of the PDF.

avoidWhen.when: Documentation: a guide or a reference with the docs navigation.
A few posts that point to articles.
One claim beside one piece of media on a landing page.

states.name: rail open
states.how: details.fd-site-article-aside[open]: kept open on desktop, summary hidden; a closed disclosure below 900px

states.name: note in view
states.how: :target and focus on the note li after an fd-site-notes-ref; its back link returns focus

states.name: copied
states.how: button[data-fd-copy-link] shows Copied for 1.4s and announces the copy

variants.useWhen: One reading column: a blog post, a newsletter issue, a customer story.
A long paper with sections: the rail holds the contents, key facts and the download.
A report's front page: the head and key facts across the container over a wide texture or figure.
aside: the rail before the text (the default reading order of contents).
aside: the rail after the text, when the key facts matter more than the contents.

parts.role: The section: an article element with fd-site-section.
Breadcrumb, eyebrow, title, standfirst, meta, actions; an fd-kv in it sits at its end on desktop.
The page's h1, a step above a section title (display size under cover).
One or two sentences: the fluid lead.
Authors, a time, reading time or the format, over a rule.
cover: a wide frame of the signature texture, or an fd-doc-frame.
The aside (aside only) and the text.
aside: a details.fd-disclosure with fd-toc, fd-kv and a download.
The text, with fd-prose data-size=lg; [data-breakout] children span wider than the measure.
The byline: a list of fd-site-authors-item.
One author: optional fd-avatar, name, role or affiliation.
Footnotes: an ol whose li#note-n are focus targets.
In the text: sup > a#ref-n to the note, aria-describedby the notes heading.
In the note: the link back to its reference, with an aria-label.
References: an ol with a hanging indent.

keyboard.does: Moves to the note and focuses it; Enter on its back link returns focus to the reference.

keyboard.keys: Enter, Space on the rail's summary
keyboard.does: Opens or closes the contents below desktop.
